goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: Approve one declarative semantic-adapter package, not selector automation. Add exact Facebook, Instagram, and target-unavailable route/landmark enums; replace the LinkedIn/Pinterest binary classifier with an explicit per-route contract; validate target match before route readiness; and preserve optional sanitized diagnostics in acceptance receipts. A preflight may be ready with a search entry before result landmarks exist. Permit exactly one evidenced in-origin native Search navigation control, then re-run the same bounded projection; never guess a URL/selector or broaden target reads. Keep receiptVersion 1.0 because the diagnostic field is optional and additive.

worker_package.objective: Implement explicit safe semantic diagnostic contracts for Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn; preserve sanitized diagnostics in browser acceptance receipts; make result landmarks interaction-phase aware; and update the three playbooks, skills, fixtures, tests, host contract, and QA documentation as one coherent package.
stop_if: Any readiness path can pass without targetMatched=true and the route's exact native search-entry landmark.
A fix requires a guessed URL, selector, broad tab enumeration, copied page text, account identity, or a second/broader read after failure.
Results landmarks remain mandatory before an autocomplete interaction begins.
Facebook or Instagram labels remain outside the typed contract or harness allowlist.
LinkedIn authenticated Feed/navigation can pass without linkedin_native_search_entry.
The optional receipt diagnostic can contain unbounded or non-enumerated strings.
A required change falls outside allowed_files.
Verification fails twice for a task-introduced reason.

missing_evidence: T003 must prove the explicit route/landmark contract and phase-aware harness behavior with focused and offline verification.
T006 must prove the declarative contract against fresh existing-Chrome surfaces; fixtures alone cannot complete the goal.
required_board_updates: Copy worker_package exactly onto T003 before activation.
Keep the implementation as one coherent write package.
